name: Ruled Notebook
rationale: An original study desk vocabulary: flat ivory stock, hand-ruled cobalt pen, a restrained oxblood margin and small brass stationery details. Icons use individually drafted silhouettes and fine paper keylines, rather than a repeated decorative container. Ruled texture sits well below reading contrast; visual weight belongs to the actual content.

masterySemantics.unknown: A clean indexed slip: the concept is filed but not yet understood.
masterySemantics.partial: A large sharpened pencil: active working and unfinished reasoning.
masterySemantics.clear: An open notebook with a checked worked page: the reasoning is readable and understood.
masterySemantics.mastered: A bound, ribbon-marked notebook with a checked cover: knowledge has been consolidated.

contrastRecommendations.lightText: Use graphite #273444 on ivory #F6F0DF; cobalt #244A88 for links and active controls.
contrastRecommendations.darkText: Use ivory #F6F0DF on the graphite-blue menu #263344.
contrastRecommendations.secondary: Use #686356 for muted prose on ivory. Brass is an ornament, not small body text.
contrastRecommendations.icons: Ivory-filled objects and a narrow ivory keyline preserve pen geometry against both light and dark UI surfaces.
